phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا كَافِيَ الْفَرْدِ الضَعِيْفِ، وَوَاقِيَ الامْرِ الْمَخُوْفِ،
phrases.english: 1.O God, O Sufficer of the isolated and weak and Protector against terrifying affairs!

phrases.arabic: أَفْرَدَتْنِي الْخَـطَايَا; فَـلاَ صَاحِبَ مَعِي،
phrases.english: 2.Offenses have isolated me, so there is none to be my companion.

phrases.arabic: وَضَعُفْتُ عَنْ غَضَبِكَ; فَلاَ مُؤَيِّدَ لِي،
phrases.english: 3.I am too weak for Your wrath and there is none to strengthen me.

phrases.arabic: وَأَشْرَفْتُ عَلَى خَوْفِ لِقَائِكَ; فَلاَ مُسَكِّنَ لِرَوْعَتِي،
phrases.english: 4.I have approached the terror of meeting You and there is none to still my fear.

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنُنِي مِنْكَ وَأَنْتَ أَخَفْتَنِي؟
phrases.english: 5.Who can make me secure from You when You hast filled me with terror?

phrases.arabic: وَمَن يساعِدُنِي وَأَنْتَ أَفْرَدْتَنِي؟
phrases.english: 6.Who can come to my aid when You hast isolated me?

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ يُقَوِّيْنِي وَأَنْتَ أَضْعَفْتَنِي؟
phrases.english: 7.Who can strengthen me when You hast weakened me?

phrases.arabic: لاَ يُجيرُ يا إلهي إلاّ رَبٌّ عَلَى مَرْبُوب،
phrases.english: 8.None can grant sanctuary to a vassal, my God, but a lord,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يُؤْمِنُ إلاّ غالِبٌ عَلَى  مَغْلُوب،
phrases.english: 9.none can give security to one dominated but a dominator,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يُعِينُ إِلاّ طالِبٌ عَلَى مَطْلُوب،
phrases.english: 10.none can aid him from whom demands are made but a demander.

phrases.arabic: وَبِيَـدِكَ يَـاَ إلهِي جَمِيعُ ذلِكَ السَّبَبِ، وَإلَيْكَ الْمَفَرُّ وَالْمَهْربُ.
phrases.english: 11.In Your hand, my God, is the thread of all that, in You the place of escape and flight,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 12.so bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَأَجِرْ هَرَبِي وَأَنْجِحْ مَطْلَبِي.
phrases.english: 13.give sanctuary to me in my flight, and grant my request!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ إنْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي وَجْهَكَ الْكَرِيْمَ،
phrases.english: 14.O God, if You shouldst turn Your generous face away from me,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ مَنَعْتَنِي فَضْلَكَ الْجَسِيمَ،
phrases.english: 15.withhold from me Your immense bounty,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ حَظَرْتَ عَلَيَّ رِزْقَكَ أَوْ قَطَعْتَ عَنِّي سَبَبَـكَ
phrases.english: 16.forbid me Your provision, or cut off from me Your thread,

phrases.arabic: لَمْ أَجِدِ السَّبِيـلَ إلَى شَيْء مِنْ أَمَلِي غَيْرَكَ،
phrases.english: 17.I will find no way to anything of my hope other than You

phrases.arabic: وَلَمْ أَقْدِرْ عَلَى مَا عِنْدَكَ بِمَعُونَةِ  سِوَاكَ; فَإنِّي عَبْدُكَ،
phrases.english: 18.nor be given power over what is with You through another's aid, for I am Your servant

phrases.arabic: وَفِي قَبْضَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، لاَ أَمْرَ لِي مَعَ أَمْرِكَ،
phrases.english: 19.and in Your grasp; my forelock is in Your hand. I have no command along with Your command.

phrases.arabic: مَاض فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ،
phrases.english: 20.'Accomplished is Your judgement of me, just Your decree for me!'

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ قُوَّةَ لِي عَلَى الْخُـرُوجِ مِنْ سُلْطَانِـكَ،
phrases.english: 21.I have not the strength to emerge from Your authority

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ أَسْتَطِيـعُ مُجَاوَزَةَ قُدْرَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 22.nor am I able to step outside Your power.

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ أَسْتَـمِيلُ هَوَاكَ، وَلاَ أبْلُغُ رِضَاكَ،
phrases.english: 23.I cannot win Your inclination, arrive at Your good pleasure,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ أَنَالُ مَا عِنْدَكَ إلاَّ بِطَاعَتِكَ وَبِفَضْل رَحْمَتِكَ.
phrases.english: 24.or attain what is with You except through obeying You and through the bounty of Your mercy.

phrases.arabic: إلهِي أَصْبَحْتُ وَأَمْسَيْتُ عَبْداً دَاخِراً لَكَ،
phrases.english: 25.O God, I rise in the morning and enter into evening as Your lowly slave.

phrases.arabic: لا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي نَفْعاً وَلاَ ضَرّاً إلاَّ بِكَ
phrases.english: 26.I own no profit and loss for myself except through You.

phrases.arabic: أَشْهَدُ بِذَلِكَ عَلَى نَفْسِي وَأَعْتَـرِفُ بِضَعْفِ قُـوَّتِي وَقِلَّةِ حِيْلَتِي
phrases.english: 27.I witness to that over myself and I confess to the frailty of my strength and the paucity of my stratagems.

phrases.arabic: فَأَنْجزْ لِي مَا وَعَدْتَنِي،  وَتَمِّمْ لِي مَا آتَيْتَنِي;
phrases.english: 28.So accomplish what You hast promised me and complete for me what You hast given me,

phrases.arabic: فَإنِّي عَبْـدُكَ الْمِسْكِينُ الْمُسْتكِينُ الضَّعِيفُ
phrases.english: 29.for I am Your slave, miserable, abased, frail,

phrases.arabic: الضَّـرِيـرُ الذَّلِيلُ الْحَقِيرُ الْمَهِينُ الْفَقِيرُ الْخَائِفُ الْمُسْتَجِيرُ.
phrases.english: 30.distressed, vile, despised, poor, fearful, and seeking sanctuary!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 31.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي نَاسِيَاً لِذِكْرِكَ فِيمَا أَوْلَيْتَنِي،
phrases.english: 32.and let me not forget to remember You in what You hast done for me,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ غافِلاً لإحْسَانِكَ فِيمَا أَبْلَيْتَنِي،
phrases.english: 33.be heedless of Your beneficence in Your trying me,

phrases.arabic: وَلا آيسَاً مِنْ إجَابَتِكَ لِي وَإنْ أَبْطَأتَ عَنِّي
phrases.english: 34.or despair of Your response to me, though it keep me waiting,

phrases.arabic: فِي سَرَّاءَ كُنْتُ أَوْ ضَرَّاءَ، أَوْ شِدَّة أَوْ رَخَاء،
phrases.english: 35.whether I be in prosperity or adversity, hardship or ease,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ عَافِيَة أَوْ بَلاء، أَوْ بُؤْس أَوْ نَعْمَاءَ،
phrases.english: 36.well-being or affliction, misery or comfort,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ جِدَة  أَوْ لأوَاءَ، أَوْ فَقْر أَوْ غِنىً.
phrases.english: 37.wealth or distress, poverty or riches!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 38.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ ثَنائِي عَلَيْكَ وَمَدْحِي إيَّاكَ
phrases.english: 39.make me laud You, extol You,

phrases.arabic: وَحَمْدِي لَكَ فِي كُلِّ حَالاَتِي
phrases.english: 40.and praise You in all my states

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ أَفْرَحَ بِمَا آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الدُّنْيَا،
phrases.english: 41.so that I rejoice not over what You givest me of this world

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ أَحْـزَنَ عَلَى مَا مَنَعْتَنِي فِيهَا،
phrases.english: 42.nor sorrow over that of it which You withholdest from me!

phrases.arabic: وَأَشْعِرْ قَلْبِي تَقْوَاكَ،
phrases.english: 43.Impart reverential fear of You to my heart,

phrases.arabic: وَاسْتَعْمِلْ بَدَنِي فِيْمَا تَقْبَلُهُ مِنِّي،
phrases.english: 44.employ my body in that which You acceptest from me,

phrases.arabic: وَاشْغَلْ بِطَاعَتِكَ نَفْسِي  عَنْ كُلِّ مَايَرِدُ عَلَىَّ
phrases.english: 45.and divert my soul through obedience to You from all that enters upon me,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ اُحِبَّ شَيْئَاً مِنْ سُخْطِكَ،
phrases.english: 46.so that I love nothing that displeases You

phrases.arabic: وَلا أَسْخَطَ شَيْئـاً مِنْ رِضَـاكَ.
phrases.english: 47.and become displeased at nothing that pleases You!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 48.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَفَرِّغْ قَلْبِي لِمَحَبَّتِكَ ، وَاشْغَلْهُ بِذِكْرِكَ،
phrases.english: 49.empty my heart for Your love, occupy it with remembering You,

phrases.arabic: وَانْعَشْهُ بِخَوْفِكَ ، وَبِالْوَجَلِ مِنْكَ،
phrases.english: 50.animate it with fear of You and quaking before You,

phrases.arabic: وَقَوِّهِ بِالرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ، وَأَمِلْهُ إلَى طَاعَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 51.strengthen it with beseeching You, incline it to Your obedience,

phrases.arabic: وَأَجْرِ بِهِ فِي أَحَبِّ السُّبُلِ إلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: 52.set it running in the path most beloved to You,

phrases.arabic: وَذَلِّلْهُ بِالرَّغْبَةِ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ أَيَّامَ حَيَاتِي كُلِّهَا،
phrases.english: 53.and subdue it through desire for what is with You all the days of my life!

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ تَقْوَاكَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا زَادِي،
phrases.english: 54.Let my provision in this world be reverential fear of You (ref. 2:197),

phrases.arabic: وَإلَى رَحْمَتِكَ رِحْلَتِي، وَفِي مَرْضَاتِكَ مَدْخَلِي.
phrases.english: 55.my journey be toward Your mercy, and my entrance be into Your good pleasure!

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ فِي جَنَّتِكَ مَثْوَايَ،
phrases.english: 56.Appoint for me a lodging in Your Garden,

phrases.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي قُوَّةً أَحْتَمِلُ بِهَا جَمِيعَ مَرْضَاتِكَ،
phrases.english: 57.give me strength to bear everything that pleases You,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ فِرَارِي إلَيْكَ، وَرَغْبَتِي فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ،
phrases.english: 58.make me flee to You and desire what is with You,

phrases.arabic: وَأَلْبِسْ قَلْبِي الْوَحْشَةَ مِنْ شِرارِ  خَلْقِكَ.
phrases.english: 59.clothe my heart in estrangement from the evil among Your creatures,

phrases.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي الأُنْسَ بِكَ وَبِأَوْلِيَـآئِكَ وَأَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 60.and give me intimacy with You, Your friends, and those who obey You!

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ لِـفَاجِـر وَلا كَافِر  عَلَيَّ مِنَّةً،
phrases.english: 61.Assign to no wicked person or unbeliever a kindness toward me

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ لَـهُ عِنْدِي يَداً، وَلا بِي إلَيْهِمْ حَاجَةً،
phrases.english: 62.or a hand that obliges me, nor to me a need for one of them!

phrases.arabic: بَل اجْعَـلْ سُكُـونَ قَلْبِي وَاُنْسَ  نَفْسِي
phrases.english: 63.Rather make the stillness of my heart, the comfort of my soul,

phrases.arabic: وَاسْتِغْنَـائِي وَكِفَايَتِي بِكَ وَبِخِيَـارِ خَلْقِكَ.
phrases.english: 64.my independence and my sufficiency lie in You and the best of Your creatures!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ،
phrases.english: 65.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِي  لَهُمْ قَـرِيناً، وَاجْعَلْنِي لَهُمْ نَصِيْراً،
phrases.english: 66.make me their comrade, make me their helper,

phrases.arabic: وَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِشَوْق إلَيْكَ، وَبِالْعَمَلِ لَكَ بِمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَى
phrases.english: 67.and oblige me with yearning for You and doing for You what You lovest and approvest!

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ،
phrases.english: 68."Thou art powerful over everything" (3:26)

phrases.arabic: وَذَلِكَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ .
phrases.english: 69.and that is easy for You.
